title: Kangra Fort

terrainReference.basis: Reference camera position near accessible northeast gate corridor, used as the approximate external approach datum.

mapIdentity.scope: The named twenty-control OSM archaeological precinct bounds the site. The separate sixty-control mapped masonry envelope and seventeen mapped pedestrian route controls govern the model. The outline is interpreted as rampart runs and ruined court walls.

note: A steep-sided ridge carries the fort above the two rivers. Use the frozen relief at wall toes and the approximate northeastern approach datum. Gates and wall heights follow the selected modern photographs with bounded estimates.
